description: List payments received in a time period, optionally by payment method. Refunds are included with a negative amount. Bookeo: GET /payments.

endTime.description: Period end — RFC 3339 date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T09:00:00-04:00. The offset -00:00 means the account's local timezone.

pageNavigationToken.description: Token from a previous response's info.pageNavigationToken, to fetch another page. Search parameters need not be repeated.

pageNumber.description: Page to fetch (1-based). Used together with pageNavigationToken.

paymentMethod.description: Only this payment method (Bookeo spells cheque "checque").

paymentMethodOther.description: Custom method name — required when paymentMethod is "other".

startTime.description: Period start — RFC 3339 date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T09:00:00-04:00. The offset -00:00 means the account's local timezone.

name: bookeo_list_payments
title: List payments
